This is the official MCP 2026-07-28 JSON Schema, retrieved on 2026-10-04 from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/specification/main/schema/2026-07-28/schema.json.
Its upstream license notice is preserved in LICENSE. Tests use this local snapshot
so CI does not depend on a network fetch of a changing branch.
Only the extra blank line at end of the upstream file was removed.
